faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before booking your vehicle.

items.question: What do I need to rent?
items.answer: A valid driver's license, passport or ID, and a security deposit may be required. Exact requirements vary by vehicle and are confirmed before booking.

items.question: Is insurance included?
items.answer: Coverage details and any deductible are explained in your quote and rental agreement.

items.question: Can you deliver the vehicle?
items.answer: Delivery may be available depending on location and schedule.

items.question: How do I confirm my reservation?
items.answer: After your request, IVJ confirms availability, total price, deposit and the steps required to secure the vehicle.

items.question: What's the fuel and cancellation policy?
items.answer: Fuel, cancellation, late-return and damage policies are provided with your final rental terms, before you confirm.

reservar.title: Request a reservation
reservar.subtitle: Tell us what you need — we'll confirm availability, price and the steps to secure your vehicle.
reservar.unavailable: Not available for these dates — try another category or different dates.
reservar.error_dates: The end date must be on or after the start date.
reservar.error_submit: Couldn't send the request. Please try again or message us on WhatsApp.
reservar.success_text: We'll get in touch with you shortly. You can also message us directly on WhatsApp to confirm faster:
reservar.whatsapp_message: Hi, I'd like to confirm my reservation request: {categoria}, from {inicio} to {fin}. Name: {nombre}.
